content.text: I keep seeing people treat protein smoothies like they have to taste like punishment, and that’s just bad kitchen planning. If you want something actually drinkable, start with milk or unsweetened alt milk, frozen banana, a scoop of protein, a spoon of peanut butter, and a little cocoa powder. Blend it hard with ice. content.text: I finally got my long hair to behave today without turning into a puffball by lunch, so I’m calling that a win. I washed it, let it dry halfway, then did the low, loose twist instead of fighting it with a million pins. The trick for me was keeping it a little damp, smoothing a tiny bit of leave-in through the ends, and not yanking the front too tight. If your hair is thick or stubborn, this is the kind of style that looks like effort when it really isn’t. I’m trying to keep mine healthy enough for ballroom nights and normal life both, which is harder than it sounds.
